title: Add autonomous horizontal desktop walking
objective: Make the existing Spine Move animation a regular idle behavior with real left/right desktop movement, direction changes and safe screen bounds; preserve conversation poses, fixed touch audio and long-idle sleep. Deliver locally without pushing.
architecture: Codex directly implements on the existing isolated checkout from clean b1ca6969f9be5265c7e2406b56dfb75c67776c2f. No Claude, delegation, push, PR or merge. Relevant daily-runtime public baselines are checked before mutation; unrelated original changes remain.

Add a small pure roaming controller with injectable monotonic clock/randomness. Default automatic mode rests 20–35 seconds, walks 4–7 seconds at 40 logical pixels/second and repeats while eligible. Use a 33ms Swing timer, elapsed-time motion with a bounded catch-up step, fractional positions and short bouts rather than unbounded drift. The manual Walk action starts one bout immediately when eligible, including with automatic mode disabled.

Translate the real JFrame horizontally at its current height within its current monitor's usable bounds after menu/Dock/taskbar insets. Support negative monitor coordinates, clamp at edges, reverse direction and mirror the displayed panel when moving left. Do not change Spine resources, CPU renderer, camera, scale or completed-frame painting. The original model faces right; mirroring is a display transform shared with PNG fallback.

Only IDLE/WALKING states are eligible. Pause on mouse press/drag/hover, visible chat, speech/thinking, interaction, sleep, popup menus, hidden windows or disposal. Resume after a fresh rest interval; movement cannot overwrite a user drag or jump after timer suspension. Move any visible speech bubble with the pet. A checked Autonomous walking menu option controls automatic behavior for this app session; Idle/Sleep/manual interaction stops the current bout.

Add a character-state entry for autonomous walking that never records user activity, wakes sleep, cancels interactions or overrides chat/speech. The two-minute long-idle sleep clock remains driven by real user/chat activity; automatic movement must not keep the character awake. Explicit user Walk can wake it through the existing activity hook.

Verify deterministic scheduling, direction/bounds on positive and negative displays, narrow/offscreen bounds, fractional/elapsed motion, stale timer gaps, manual override, disabling, external relocation, blockers and closure. Verify character priority/idle-sleep preservation and pixel-exact horizontal mirroring without modifying renderer output. Add opt-in native offline window validation for real position changes, boundary reversal, menu/drag/chat/sleep preemption and timer/renderer disposal; no external services or real config.

Run the existing Java/build/Spec/diff/window checks and explicit reviewed native walking/chat checks. Install only reviewed public files into the known daily runtime using frozen per-file hashes/backups, preserve launchers/private metadata/fixed audio cache and unrelated services. Run actual-runtime checks and compiled-class parity, then gracefully restart only the identified app using its unchanged free voice entry. Normal restart clears temporary conversation; no live model/TTS calls are needed.
non_goals: No remote publication, purchases, cloud calls, model/voice changes, private configuration inspection or changes to stored fixed-phrase audio.
No vertical falling, obstacle detection, cross-monitor patrol, dragging the user's other windows or persistent preference settings.
No change to idle-sleep delay, conversation pose rules, existing animation resources or Spine rendering implementation.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Idle behavior periodically plays WALK and moves the actual pet horizontally; manual Walk starts a bout and automatic walking can be disabled.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Deterministic controller scheduling/motion/manual tests plus native real-window position/animation and menu checks.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Walking stays inside the current monitor's usable rectangle, reverses at either edge, faces its movement direction and preserves its height and renderer behavior.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Geometry tests including negative coordinates/offscreen/narrow bounds, pixel mirror checks, native edge reversal and own-panel captures.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Conversation, speech, sleep, interactions, mouse/menu activity, dragging and disposal stop motion; automatic movement never resets the existing long-idle sleep clock or causes catch-up jumps.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Character/controller tests, existing native chat pose test and native walking preemption/disposal checks.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The reviewed local daily runtime starts with automatic walking enabled and all launchers, private settings, fixed touch voice and unrelated code preserved; no push or real model calls.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Scoped installation plan/guards, local and runtime checks, compiled-class parity, safe normal startup marker and local-only technical review/report.

risks: Speed/timing and screen placement are product behavior for local user acceptance; automatic mode has an immediate menu off switch.
The current monitor's work area is used; OS display/Dock changes are rechecked each tick. No cross-monitor wandering is attempted.
Native validation must omit all AI/voice/weather/reminder services and not read or display other applications. UI evidence is limited to this test window/panel.
Session-only automatic-walking preference resets to enabled on app restart; long-idle sleep remains two minutes.
rollback: Stop the identified app, restore only backed-up public files with matching installed hashes, remove only newly installed public source/test/docs files if originally absent, rebuild and use the unchanged daily launcher. Preserve all private files, voice cache and unrelated sources.
